title: Unitonomy: source-attributed financing and product observations
scope: Paraphrased public-source observations. These are interested-party reports, not independently verified transactions, legal conclusions, valuations, investor returns, or investment advice.

observations.publisher: Cory Forsyth, identified on Wefunder as Unitonomy's lead investor
observations.claim: The lead investor reported that all Unitonomy SAFE holders had converted, including the Wefunder investors whose SAFEs he exercised, into preferred stock of Unitonomy.
observations.time_precision: Reported completed by the dated update, conditional on its stated dating. Exact transaction date and historical page-version availability are unverified.
limitations: The page includes an earlier founder update that still describes the conversion opportunity prospectively.
Unitonomy's separate Details page lists zero preferred shares outstanding, without a clear date for that table. That apparent inconsistency remains unresolved.
No executed conversion documents or dated cap table were inspected. The report does not establish investor liquidity or returns.

observations.claim: The same update describes an OrgVitals financing at a $2.7 million post-money valuation and Unitonomy owning 71% of OrgVitals. It describes $1.92 million as a derived Unitonomy valuation used for the conversion.
observations.time_precision: The financing is described as recent; no exact closing date is stated.
limitations: OrgVitals and Unitonomy are distinct issuers.
The derived parent valuation is not evidence of a separately priced Unitonomy financing.

observations.publisher: Cory Forsyth, identified on Wefunder as Unitonomy's lead investor
observations.claim: The May investor update reports deployment of OrgVitals 2.0 and onboarding of three consulting groups. It distinguishes some free early adopters from customers whose platform fees begin after client deployment.
observations.time_precision: The update is labelled May and published in June. Its reference to 'today' does not establish a separately verified activity date.
limitations: This is an OrgVitals product-level activity report, not proof of continuous operation or an independently verified revenue amount.
It does not establish the operating status of the Unitonomy holding company or investor returns.

context_source.claim: An earlier update describes separate subsidiary cap tables and prospective Unitonomy SAFE conversion paperwork. It provides chronology and entity context, not evidence that conversion was already complete in April.

access_limit: The financial-notes document linked from the public Details page could not be retrieved. Its contents were not used.
